title: Fields in a protocol
description:
Guess the fields of a protocol from captured messages of a program you wrote.

```
12 messages of the same type
bytes 0-1: constant 0xAB 0xCD (magic)
byte 2: counts up 1, 2, 3 ... (sequence number)
byte 3: equals message length - 4 (length)
bytes 4+: varies (payload)
```
hints: "Counting up" means each message's byte is the previous one's plus 1 (lesson 6.03).
Try the length test for small constants (0 to 8) and keep the one that fits every message.
requirements: For each byte position, test: constant, counting up, equal to the length minus a constant, or varying.
Only compare positions every message has.
Print one line per field, merging neighbouring bytes with the same kind.
stretch: Detect 16-bit little-endian fields across two positions.
